text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert: release tag v2.14.3-canary (canary-2026-03-15). Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 canary cluster — current error rate 23% over 2m. Autoscaler notes spike in p95 latency. Logs: `model-serving: kv-cache-miss` repeated.
Alex K: seeing same in datadog, graphs spiking at 14:32 PST. Not a full outage yet but traffic routed to canary only. :eyes:
Maria T: any rollout changes? last commit was small tokenizer patch, SHA `a1b2c3d4` — could be compatibility with quantized weights.
Sam R: I'm oncall. Paging per oncall-bot.
oncall-bot: @Sam R (primary) has been paged for incidents in #incidents. See runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/canary-failures
Sam R: ACK. I'll take lead. Starting triage.
Ingrid L: symptoms from traces: model worker crashes with OOM for sequences > 1024, but only on canary machines (A100-40GB). Prod (bigger nodes) unaffected.
Priya P: Product ops says a handful of customers on canary saw latency spikes and 502s — one enterprise tenant reported degraded embedding jobs. Suspected customer impact = partial; flagged for SLA watch.
Alex K: stacktrace shows `bad alignment in fused attention kernel` after tokenizer change. Pretty specific.
Maria T: can we kill the feature flag that rolled this tokeniser change? flag key `tokenizer_v2_rollout` currently true on canary.
Sam R: yes let's flip it if it's just a feature flag. Ingrid, any objections?
Ingrid L: safe to toggle, it only affects canary. Do it and watch metrics. If flip doesn't help we fallback to single-commit revert.
Alex K: toggling now: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_API" https://flags.internal/ops/tokenizer_v2_rollout/disable -d '{"scope":"canary"}'`
product-ops-bot: Feature flag `tokenizer_v2_rollout` disabled for scope=canary by Alex K. :white_check_mark:
Sam R: monitoring — error rate dropping to 7%… 3m later 1.2%. Nice. Latency returns to baseline. Will hold for 15m to confirm.
Priya P: notifying affected customers with canned message. Sending to rails for incident notice.
Alex K: quick note — even though flag flip fixed it, the underlying commit is still bad on canary. Recommend a revert in main to avoid accidental promotion.
Maria T: agreed. Small revert PR: `git revert --no-commit a1b2c3d4 && git commit -m "revert: tokenizer v2 rollout cause kernel misalignment"`
Sam R: Create PR and request urgent review from runtime and infra. If we can deploy a single-commit revert to canary-prod path and ensure no promotion, do it.
Ingrid L: runtime team: we should add a guard to skip fused attention on affected kernel path as a short-term safety, but that's more invasive. Revert is fastest.
Alex K: PR created: https://git/repo/pulls/4821 — tagging @Maria T @Ingrid L. CI is green for unit tests, integration checks running.
product-ops-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR 4821. Status: in-progress.
Sam R: if PR merge is slower than we like, prepare rollback of the canary tag from the release controller: `rc rollback --tag canary-2026-03-15 --to-tag canary-2026-03-14` — we can do controlled rollback without touching main.
Maria T: merge went through, deploying to canary-only first. Deploy command:
```
deployctl promote --pr 4821 --env canary --strategy canary --max-in-flight 10
```
Alex K: canary deploy finishing, smoke tests running.
oncall-bot: smoke test: generate api — OK. Latency p95 in canary: 120ms (baseline 115ms). Error rate <0.5%.
Sam R: good. Promote to staggered rollout? We should NOT promote to dedicated or prod until we validate additional 30m.
Priya P: comms update: initial customer notice sent. Waiting on final assessment before sending formal incident summary.
Ingrid L: I'll open a postmortem ticket: PM-INC-2026-0315-01. Need root cause: tokenizer change triggered kernel path that misaligned fused attention buffers for quantized models on A100-40GB.
Alex K: action items: 1) revert commit merged (done), 2) add preflight kernel compatibility test to CI (runtime), 3) add feature-flag safety net to auto-disable on 5xx spike (ops).
Sam R: on-call handoff notes for next shift (@Maria T at 23:00 UTC): watch canary error rate and customer ticket queue. If error rate >3% for 5m, re-open channel and escalate to infra.
Maria T: ACK handoff. I'll keep an eye. Closing incident thread in 40m if stable.
product-ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV-3. No SLA breaches identified. :information_source:
Priya P: will prepare external-facing summary and internal timeline. Draft ETA 2 hours.
Alex K: posting logs snapshot to the ticket and linking stacktrace. Also tagging kernel team for follow-up.
Sam R: thanks everyone — nice quick coordination. Leaving a short blameless note in the ticket about risky tokenizer change.
product-ops-bot: Incident thread archived in 6h unless reopened. :page_with_curl:
